{{Top|leg}}
The '''Pre-Settlement era''' was a period of time on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. ''[[Castle Bocce]]'', a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] and [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], was originally constructed in the Pre-Settlement era.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
